headline.purpose: Responsive page heading in the user-confirmed system sans stack.

answer.purpose: Preserved whitespace and a generous reading line height.

motion.name: source-selection
motion.purpose: Selected-source background highlight, only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Ask a question using the configured answer model.
components.css: .ds-primary {font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;background: var(--blue, #174fa5); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); } .ds-primary:hover:enabled { background: #103e85; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Find sources, or stop a running request.
components.css: .ds-secondary {font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; background: #fff; color: #202b36; border: 1px solid #9babbc; } .ds-secondary:hover:enabled { background: #edf1f5; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.48; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Question field
components.description: A labeled, vertically resizable question field.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-question">Your question</label><textarea class="ds-question" id="ds-question" rows="3" placeholder="What happens when I delete an object in a versioned bucket?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; color: #202b36; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; } .ds-question { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 7rem; resize: vertical; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #202b36; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #9babbc; border-radius: 6px; caret-color: var(--blue, #174fa5); } .ds-question::placeholder { color: #647181; opacity: 1; } .ds-question:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-question:disabled { background: #f7f8fa; color: var(--muted, #526170); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Home wordmark
components.description: Compact home navigation with a quiet descriptor on wider screens.
components.html: S3 Knowledge EngineDocumentation workspace
components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1.7rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dee5); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-wordmark { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #202b36; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-masthead > span { color: var(--muted, #526170); font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-masthead { padding: 1.2rem 0; } .ds-masthead > span { display: none; } }

components.name: Question form surface
components.description: The white rounded question container, with no shadow.
components.html: <form class="ds-form"><label class="ds-form-label" for="ds-form-question">Your question</label><textarea class="ds-form-question" id="ds-form-question" rows="3"></textarea></form>
components.css: .ds-form { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #202b36; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dee5); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.35rem 1.5rem; } .ds-form-label { display: block; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 650; margin-bottom: 0.65rem; } .ds-form-question { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 7rem; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; resize: vertical; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #202b36; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #9babbc; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-form-question:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-form { padding: 1rem; } }

components.name: Inline citation
components.description: An inline button that selects and focuses a cited passage.
components.css: .ds-citation { display: inline; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.2rem 0.4rem; margin: 0 0.15rem; background: var(--blue-soft, #eaf1fb); color: var(--blue, #174fa5); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; vertical-align: baseline; cursor: pointer; } .ds-citation:hover { background: #d9e7fa; } .ds-citation:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Selected source row
components.description: A numbered source with visible and semantic selected state.
components.css: .ds-source { display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 0.8rem; width: 100%; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #202b36; background: transparent; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dee5); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dee5); padding: 0.85rem 0.6rem; text-align: left; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-source[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--blue-soft, #eaf1fb); } .ds-source:hover { background: #eaf0f7; } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #174fa5); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-source-number { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 1.5rem; text-align: center; color: var(--blue, #174fa5); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 650; padding-top: 0.15rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-source strong { display: block; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.45; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-source-kind { display: block; color: var(--muted, #526170); font-size: 0.75rem; margin-top: 0.3rem; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-source[aria-pressed="true"] { animation: ds-select-source 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-select-source { from { background: #cddff8; } to { background: var(--blue-soft, #eaf1fb); } } }

narrative.overview:
The interface extends the existing light neutral starter. Pale gray ground, white reading surfaces, dark slate text, and restrained blue controls make questions and source passages easy to scan. System typography is the confirmed incumbent choice; this document records that choice without proposing a replacement identity.

This is an extracted record of `frontend/app/globals.css` and `frontend/app/page.tsx`. Tokens describe reused shipped values; they do not establish a new component library. Product behavior remains in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md), and the question-and-sources surface contract remains in [search_surface.md](search_surface.md).
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light surfaces with blue interaction cues.
Flat grouping through whitespace and fine rules.
Comfortable reading measures and visible source selection.
Explicit provisional, empty, stopped, and failed states.

rules.name: The Interaction Cue Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies an action, a selected source, or request activity; neutral surfaces carry reading content.

rules.name: The Passage Fidelity Rule
rules.body: Preserve passage whitespace and wrap long strings; original text is read in the same sans family as the interface rather than restyled as a code block.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve the incumbent hierarchy of rules and tonal fills when extending an existing container.

dos: Do retain neutral reading surfaces and blue interaction cues.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and native form semantics.
Do preserve passage whitespace and wrap long source identifiers.
Do stack the source inspector below the answer at the existing mobile breakpoint.
Do keep provisional answer states and source provenance explicit.
donts: Don't introduce a new visual identity into this bounded extension.
Don't use selection or error color as the only state explanation.
Don't add shadows to the existing flat containers.
Don't make the source-selection animation run for reduced-motion users.
Don't imply that checked citation membership proves factual support.
